description: Hospital Estates and Facilities Statistics were the central source of information on estates and facilities services in the NHS in England, covering the size of the estate, the quality of its buildings, energy efficiency and sustainability, hospital cleaning and hospital food. They were published by the Department of Health as official statistics not designated as National Statistics; the data.gov.uk entry, under the Department of Health and Social Care, links to the Department's transparency pages as captured in the UK Government Web Archive on 2 April 2013. Coverage is NHS organisations in England for the years captured. Access: archived web pages and files only; NHS England Digital's current estates collection page returned a Cloudflare 403 today, so its successor series could not be read. Licence: Open Government Licence per the data.gov.uk entry; free. Caveats: an archived series; use current NHS estates returns for recent years. Simulation uses: hospital building condition, backlog maintenance and energy use for critical facility resilience and capacity planning. Related records: NHS Hospitals - Scotland and healthsites.io.
name: Hospital Estates and Facilities Statistics (NHS England, archived Department of Health series)
notes: Successor collection (Estates Returns Information Collection) page at digital.nhs.uk returned 403 on 2026-09-26; not described here from recall.
